verdict.rationale: Docs describe Agent Modes (Free/Power/Max) as trading off 'included allowance,' 'credits,' and capability before sending a request, giving founders a general framework for anticipating consumption, but there is no granular breakdown of what specific actions (e.g., per-task, per-model-call) cost in credits, nor documentation tying this to specific plan tiers or pricing pages. Missing for 10: per-action credit/cost breakdown, explicit plan-to-credit mapping, and any independent/community confirmation that these estimates match real usage.
